supersedes_claims.claim: A successful NanoVMS Stop is evidence of completed DELETE
supersedes_claims.correction: Withdrawn. The adapter called Stop, and its fixture removed the mock resource on Stop. Neither proved resource deletion. Existing transport/read/create evidence remains bounded to the actual cases and checkouts; deletion capability and live-provider acceptance remain open.

supersedes_claims.claim: The HTTP lifecycle fixture demonstrated a durable process restart
supersedes_claims.correction: It reconstructed or reused in-memory adapter state. No database durability or separate-process restart was demonstrated.

supersedes_claims.claim: Every earlier PR workflow tested the branch head recorded in its run metadata
supersedes_claims.correction: Default checkout jobs often tested a synthetic PR merge. The new focused oracles explicitly check out and verify the branch SHA; prior evidence must retain its actual checkout/configuration.

sharecli.scope: Linux local-filesystem queue ownership and recovery; not complete B03/B05/B06 acceptance
implementation: A waiter requires a held exclusive kernel file lock; a live/reused PID does not prove ownership.
A waiter is locked before unique no-clobber publication; shared probes do not create phantom exclusive owners.
Per-lane sequence allocation and publication are serialized across processes; FIFO does not use PID or wall-clock ties.
Old unleased files are ignored, not attributed or unlinked by peers. Torn ordering-journal tails fail closed.
The previous 28 queue test contracts are retained with real held-lease positive fixtures; ten ownership/journal tests and a real child-death integration test are added.
not_qualified: mature scheduler quality or full product acceptance

byteport.scope: adapter capability, action/resource identity, lifecycle authority and deletion outcome
implementation: NanoVMSDeletionTransport is distinct from Stop. Ordinary NanoVMSHTTPTransport does not implement Delete and no longer advertises it.
A deletion-capable adapter requires exact action/operation/desired/realized/provider/target/sandbox identity, calls Delete rather than Stop, and observes absence before reporting completion.
Retained resources, ambiguous acknowledgement and failed observation remain UNKNOWN.
CREATE rejects mismatched action identity, observe-only/unknown lifecycle, blank operations and cancelled contexts before transport I/O.
Positive lifecycle removal is now a clearly named test-only provider API; Stop retains a stopped resource. A separate negative HTTP test checks that Stop cannot satisfy Delete.

local_native_evidence.environment: go1.23.2 linux/amd64; isolated real source package; fixture transports
